definitions.explanation: A journey to a destination and back; travel in both directions.
Movement or communication going back and forth repeatedly.

examples.japanese: {往復|おうふく}{切符|きっぷ}を{買|か}った{方|ほう}が{安|やす}い。
examples.english: It's cheaper to buy a round-trip ticket.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}から{大阪|おおさか}まで{往復|おうふく}で{三時間|さんじかん}かかる。
examples.english: It takes three hours round trip from Tokyo to Osaka.

examples.japanese: {往復|おうふく}で{二時間|にじかん}かかる。
examples.english: It takes two hours round trip.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}の{往復|おうふく}{運賃|うんちん}はいくらですか。
examples.english: How much is the round-trip airfare?

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{会社|かいしゃ}と{家|いえ}を{往復|おうふく}している。
examples.english: I commute back and forth between home and the office every day.

examples.japanese: メールの{往復|おうふく}で{話|はなし}がまとまった。
examples.english: We reached an agreement through an exchange of emails.

examples.japanese: {手紙|てがみ}の{往復|おうふく}が{続|つづ}いた。
{二人|ふたり}の{間|あいだ}で{意見|いけん}の{往復|おうふく}があった。
examples.english: There was a back-and-forth exchange of opinions between the two.

examples.japanese: ボールを{往復|おうふく}させて{練習|れんしゅう}する。
examples.english: Practice by hitting the ball back and forth.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も{往復|おうふく}して{荷物|にもつ}を{全部|ぜんぶ}{運|はこ}んだ。
examples.english: I went back and forth many times to carry all the luggage.

notes:
USAGE: {往復|おうふく} is commonly used for transportation and travel.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{往復|おうふく}{切符|きっぷ} (round-trip ticket)
・{往復|おうふく}{運賃|うんちん} (round-trip fare)
・{往復|おうふく}はがき (return postcard - has reply section attached)
・{往復|おうふく}{書簡|しょかん} (correspondence, exchange of letters)

PATTERNS:
・{往復|おうふく}で〜 (round trip, takes ~)
・{往復|おうふく}する (to make a round trip)

CONTRAST:
・{片道|かたみち} - one way (opposite)
